phase_goals.goal: Zero remaining: all findings fixed and verified

findings.title: Unauthenticated task registry + access_token in redirect
findings.desc: POST /v1/tasks accepts arbitrary task_id/access_token (no auth). /v1/tasks/{id}/content 307-redirects to upstream URL embedding access_token -> token leaks into Location header, browser history, proxy logs, Referer.
findings.sug: Optionally require an API key (env) for write endpoints; for content, prefer ?stream=1 default or strip access_token exposure (proxy streaming only).

findings.title: Unbounded TASKS dict
findings.desc: _prune_tasks only invoked inside _create_generation_impl; a registry-heavy read-only workload never prunes; TASKS grows until process restart.
findings.sug: Prune on a periodic timer or inside _resolve_task/_get_status.

findings.title: Pseudo-streaming buffers whole MP4 in memory
findings.desc: StreamingResponse(iter([r.content])) first downloads the full file into memory, then yields one chunk; defeats streaming and doubles peak memory.
findings.sug: Use curl_cffi streaming (r.iter_content) wrapped in an async generator and pass Content-Length through.

findings.title: MM_XFF env injected unvalidated into X-Forwarded-For
findings.desc: Env-controlled header value; malformed or multi-IP strings forwarded verbatim; could inject CR or odd formats (defensive, not exploitable here, but unhygienic).
findings.sug: Validate with a strict IP/CSV regex before use.

findings.title: Zero logging
findings.desc: No logging at all ¡ª upstream failures, cookie refresh attempts, task creation events invisible.
findings.sug: Add stdlib logging (INFO lifecycle, WARNING upstream 4xx/5xx, ERROR refresh failure).

findings.title: Unlocked TASKS mutation
findings.desc: _get_status writes TASKS.setdefault without lock; races with _prune_tasks in async loop.
findings.sug: asyncio.Lock around registry mutation or single-writer pattern.

findings.title: :await poll ignores client disconnect
findings.desc: Polling continues after client disconnects (uvicorn cancels the task eventually on some setups; not guaranteed).

findings.title: God-module
findings.desc: All logic in one 358-line file; acceptable at this size but boundary already visible (client vs provider vs routes).
findings.sug: Consider split if features grow; record as decision, not fix.

findings.title: No upstream timeout/retry policy on GETs
findings.desc: Status/content GETs use fixed timeouts, no retry, no backoff; transient CF 5xx bubbles straight to caller as 502.
findings.sug: Small bounded retry with exponential backoff for idempotent GETs.

diagnoses.root: wrapper designed as a localhost/dev tool; no auth layer by design. Token-in-URL is inherent to the upstream API (its own URLs embed access_token). True fix = keep 302 default but add API-key gate on write endpoints; proxy-stream default avoids token-in-URL when `stream` not asked.
diagnoses.detail: Add optional API_KEY env gate for write endpoints (POST /v1/generations*, POST /v1/tasks). Leave redirect behavior but default content endpoint to proxy stream unless `redirect=1`.
Move prune into _resolve_task/_get_status (cheap pass) and background task on startup.
async generator yielding iter_content chunks + pass-through Content-Length.
Validate MM_XFF against IP/CSV allowlist; reject invalid.
logging.getLogger('mmtrial-wrap'); INFO on create/refresh; WARNING on upstream failure.
await request.is_disconnected() in :await loop via threading.Event checked inside loop.
Bounded 2-retry exponential for GETs on 5xx/network error.
